description: Hi! I'm a student developer from Ethiopia passionate about technology, AI, and solving real-world problems. I have experience with Python, JavaScript, React, web development, and hardware projects. I'm joining NASA Space Apps to collaborate, learn, and build something meaningful. I'm looking for teammates skilled in data science, NASA data, GIS, UI/UX, agriculture, or climate science. Most importantly, I value creativity, teamwork, and curiosity. Let's build something amazing!
